regulation_clause.text: Closure requests must be honoured within 7 working days (subject to dues); failure incurs a penalty of Rs 500 per calendar day of delay until closure, provided no outstanding.

gold.gold_rationale: The program's own header comment claims 'SLA WINDOW IN WORKING DAYS, ACCRUAL IN CALENDAR DAYS', matching clause 19. But algebraically, WS-SLA-BREACH-DAY = CAL-ELAPSED - (WORK-ELAPSED - 7), so WS-DELAY-CAL-DAYS = CAL-ELAPSED - WS-SLA-BREACH-DAY reduces to exactly WORK-ELAPSED - 7 (lines 31-34) -- despite the 'CAL' naming, the value actually penalized is a working-day delta, not a calendar-day count. The implemented day_basis does not match the calendar_day requirement.

prediction.rationale: The clause requires Rs 500 per calendar day of delay after the seven-working-day window. Lines 31–34 calculate WS-DELAY-CAL-DAYS as WS-CAL-DAYS-ELAPSED minus (WS-CAL-DAYS-ELAPSED minus (WS-WORK-DAYS-ELAPSED minus 7)), which reduces to WS-WORK-DAYS-ELAPSED minus 7. The penalty therefore accrues by excess working days rather than calendar days.
